title: WWE’s Most Iconic Superstars Have the Apparel to Match, From Stone Cold Steve Austin to the Undertaker
summary: Ahead of Raw and SmackDown each week, rep WWE Superstars spanning the Attitude Era to today.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

WWE has gone through plenty of eras, but few have left a mark quite like the Golden Era and Attitude Era. From The Undertaker’s larger-than-life presence to “Stone Cold” Steve Austin’s rebellious persona, the Superstars of those generations helped turn WWE into a pop culture phenomenon.

Their impact can still be felt today, whether fans are tuning into WWE Raw and WWE SmackDown each week, playing WWE 2K26 or looking for ways to rep their favorite Superstars. WWE apparel inspired by legendary and current Superstars gives longtime fans a way to revisit the eras they grew up watching while introducing newer fans to some of wrestling’s most recognizable names.

The Undertaker debuted in 1990 during WWE’s Golden Era and remained one of the company’s most enduring figures through the Attitude Era and beyond. Austin, meanwhile, became one of the defining faces of the Attitude Era, with his iconic “Glass Shatters” entrance music becoming instantly recognizable to fans.

The shirt lineup spans generations, too, with picks inspired by Rob Van Dam’s memorable WWE run and Rhea Ripley, one of the company’s biggest modern Superstars.

THE WHOLE F'N SHOW

Rob Van Dam Complex Unisex x WWE T-Shirt

$45

Buy Now on fANATICS

Ships for free with code SCHOOL.

Before today’s Superstars were taking over Raw and SmackDown, Rob Van Dam was making a name for himself with his signature high-flying style. This Complex x WWE tee is a wearable throwback to one of WWE’s most memorable fan favorites.

EC-DUB! EC-DUB!

ECW Complex Unisex x WWE Hardcore Adjustable Hat

$50

One size fits all, with adjustable snap closure.

If you remember when ECW brought its anything-goes energy to the wrestling world, this hat is an easy way to rep that legacy. The black Complex x WWE style features the iconic ECW branding for a subtle nod to one of wrestling’s most influential promotions.

FOR THE MAMI FANS

Rhea Ripley Complex x WWE x Ken Carson Unisex T-Shirt

$55

Made from 100% cotton.

Rhea Ripley and Ken Carson might not be the crossover you expected, but the collab makes a lot of sense. This black Complex x WWE x Ken Carson tee brings Carson’s darker aesthetic to one of WWE’s most recognizable Superstars, making it a standout pick for fans of both wrestling and rap.

IF YOU SMELL…

The Rock Complex Boxy Bring It T-Shirt

Features distressed screen print graphics both on the front and back.

Before “The Final Boss,” there was The Rock — and longtime WWE fans remember exactly how electric his entrances could be. This Complex tee brings back his Attitude era with distressed graphics and a boxy fit.

D-VON, GET THE TABLES

The Dudley Boyz Complex Unisex x WWE Dudleyville T-Shirt

Ships within one business day.

Bubba Ray and D-Von Dudley helped define an era of WWE tag team wrestling, and this Complex x WWE T-shirt celebrates their legacy with bold Dudleyville graphics. It’s an easy pick for fans who still remember those legendary table spots.

THE GLASS HAS SHATTERED

"Stone Cold" Steve Austin Complex x WWE x Ken Carson Unisex T-Shirt

Officially licensed WWE gear.

Stone Cold’s entrance is one of the most recognizable in WWE history, and now the Attitude Era icon is getting the Ken Carson treatment. The black tee offers a fresh way to rep Austin while bringing wrestling and music culture together.

YOU CAN’T SEE HIM

John Cena Complex x WWE x Ken Carson Unisex T-Shirt

Available in small to XXL sizing.

John Cena’s WWE legacy includes championship wins, unforgettable rivalries and the rise of Cenation. This tee puts the 16-time world champion at the center of a music-meets-wrestling collaboration.

WHATCHA GONNA DO?

"Hollywood" Hulk Hogan Complex x WWE Boxy T-Shirt

A relaxed, boxy t-shirt made from 100% cotton.

Hulk Hogan got a whole new attitude when he became Hollywood Hulk Hogan, and this tee celebrates one of the most memorable transformations in wrestling. The black-and-white design pairs Hogan’s flexing graphics with a relaxed boxy fit.

THE RULER HAS ARRIVED

Oba Femi Complex x WWE x Ken Carson Unisex Hoodie

$90

A midweight hoodie made for moderate temps.

Oba Femi is quickly making his mark in WWE, and this black hoodie is an easy way to show your support for one of the company’s rising Superstars. The design puts The Ruler front and center while keeping the look casual and comfortable. It also features a front pouch pocket for essentials.

YOWIE WOWIE

Bray Wyatt Complex Boxy Pain T-Shirt 

$39.99

A boxy fit, 100% Cotton and bold Bray Wyatt graphics.

Bray Wyatt’s WWE run was anything but ordinary. From The Wyatt Family to The Fiend, he built a world of characters that fans still talk about today. This black boxy tee celebrates the Superstar with a bold design inspired by his unforgettable run. It’s currently available in sizes small through XL.

There’s plenty of reason to be thinking about WWE right now. After SummerSlam wrapped its two-night event in Minneapolis, the fallout continues across WWE Raw and WWE SmackDown, where new rivalries and storylines are taking shape. With Money in the Bank scheduled for Oct. 10 in New Orleans, fans have another major WWE event on the horizon.

From Attitude Era icons to today’s biggest names, these WWE apparel picks give fans a way to celebrate the Superstars, entrance music and moments that have made WWE a part of pop culture for generations.
